label.en: Every component, from source to screen and back to the SRE agent
label.zh-Hant: 所有元件：從來源到畫面，再回到 SRE agent

note.en: Untagged steps run on Dev and Prod; `Dev only` steps run only on Dev. Badges are computed from each step's `gate`, the Deployed configuration rows of `docs/feature-map.md` that turn it on (Spec 033). Bindings, crons, gateways and API routes are checked against the code and the wrangler files by `scripts/test/system-flow.test.ts` (DOC20). Run numbers are from the Dev and Prod publishers' public `/health` read on 2026-10-20 (last runs 2026-10-19 22:07 and 22:37 UTC).
note.zh-Hant: 未標記的步驟在 Dev 與 Prod 都會執行；標記 `僅 Dev` 的只在 Dev 執行。標記依每個步驟的 `gate` 計算，也就是 `docs/feature-map.md` 中 Deployed configuration 打開它的那幾列（Spec 033）。binding、cron、gateway 與 API 路由由 `scripts/test/system-flow.test.ts`（DOC20）比對程式碼與 wrangler 設定檔。執行數字取自 2026-10-20 讀取的 Dev 與 Prod 發布器公開 `/health`（最近一次執行：2026-10-19 22:07 與 22:37 UTC）。

lead.en: Each environment has its own Worker with its own crons, so Dev and Prod never share state. `cronTarget()` sends every tick that is not another job's own cron to the `publisher`. Publication was hourly until 2026-10-13 and is now daily to cut R2 cost (Spec 018).
lead.zh-Hant: 每個環境各有一個 Worker 與自己的 cron，Dev 與 Prod 不共用狀態。`cronTarget()` 把不屬於其他 job 的 tick 都交給 `publisher`。發布原本每小時一次，2026-10-13 起改為每天一次以降低 R2 成本（Spec 018）。

v.en: Review ingestion `github-reviews` and the daily cost check `cost-guard` start on this tick, outside the publication, so neither can fail it.
v.zh-Hant: review 收集 `github-reviews` 與每日成本檢查 `cost-guard` 也在這個 tick 啟動，但在發布之外執行，失敗不會影響發布。

v.en: Data can be up to about 24 hours old; a token-protected manual trigger publishes sooner.
v.zh-Hant: 資料最多約 24 小時舊；要更早發布只能用需要 token 的手動觸發。

lead.en: A run that hit a source's per-run cap runs again 5 minutes later (at most 5 times); a failed run is retried after 10, 30 and 60 minutes. One trigger causes at most 9 publications.
lead.zh-Hant: 某個來源達到單次上限的 run，5 分鐘後再跑一次（最多 5 次）；失敗的 run 在 10、30、60 分鐘後重試。一次觸發最多造成 9 次發布。

lead.en: The `digest` target at `47 22 * * *`, forty minutes after the Dev publication: the weekly digest reads the snapshot that was just published. If a publication is still running it waits 15 minutes, at most 4 times.
lead.zh-Hant: `digest` target（`47 22 * * *`），在 Dev 發布後 40 分鐘：週報讀取剛發布的快照。若發布還在跑，就延後 15 分鐘，最多 4 次。

title.zh-Hant: Prod 週報 cron（已設定、未啟用）

lead.en: Prod's `digest` entry `17 23 * * *`, forty minutes after the Prod publication at 22:37, through the `AI` binding and gateway `osskb-digest-prod`, both deployed on Prod. Until Prod sets `DIGEST_ENABLED` the tick does nothing (Spec 014 D113); the owner decided on 2026-10-28 to ship the digest there as an experimental feature.
lead.zh-Hant: Prod 的 `digest` 項目 `17 23 * * *`，在 Prod 22:37 發布後 40 分鐘，經過 `AI` binding 與 gateway `osskb-digest-prod`，兩者都已部署在 Prod。Prod 設定 `DIGEST_ENABLED` 之前，這個 tick 不做任何事（Spec 014 D113）；擁有者在 2026-10-28 決定以實驗功能把週報上 Prod。

title.zh-Hant: 貢獻者相關 job 的 cron

lead.en: Three jobs, each on its own cron; their ticks never publish and they never start or wait for one another.
lead.zh-Hant: 三個 job 各有自己的 cron；它們的 tick 不會發布，彼此也不會互相啟動或等待。

lead.en: The `retention` target at `17 10 * * *`. Its tick never publishes; with `R2_RETENTION=dry-run` it only lists and reports what would be deleted.
lead.zh-Hant: `retention` target（`17 10 * * *`）。它的 tick 不會發布；`R2_RETENTION=dry-run` 時只列出並回報會刪除哪些物件。

lead.en: The `sre-agent` target, twice a day: `30 0 * * *` and `0 11 * * *`. Its tick never publishes. Prod sets `SRE_AGENT=off` and has no cron for it.
lead.zh-Hant: `sre-agent` target，每天兩次：`30 0 * * *` 與 `0 11 * * *`。它的 tick 不會發布。Prod 設 `SRE_AGENT=off`，沒有它的 cron。

lead.en: `cronTarget()` has a `review-queue` target, but `REVIEW_QUEUE_CRON` is unset in both environments, so the job runs only on a manual trigger.
lead.zh-Hant: `cronTarget()` 有 `review-queue` target，但兩個環境都沒設 `REVIEW_QUEUE_CRON`，所以這個 job 只能手動觸發。

lead.en: Every job has a token-protected Worker route that runs it on demand: `publisher`, `digest`, `search-embedding`, `review-queue`, `github-reviews`, `cost-guard`, `identity-links`, `kip-pages`, `identity-backfill`, `sre-agent` (also the Dev fault drill) and the `retention` report. The paths are in the runbook, not here, because each call spends money.
lead.zh-Hant: 每個 job 都有一個需要 token 的 Worker 路由可以隨時執行：`publisher`、`digest`、`search-embedding`、`review-queue`、`github-reviews`、`cost-guard`、`identity-links`、`kip-pages`、`identity-backfill`、`sre-agent`（另有 Dev 的故障演練）與 `retention` 報告。路徑寫在 runbook，不放在這裡，因為每次呼叫都要花錢。

lead.en: Read with the GitHub REST API from an updated-time cursor, at most 200 issues per repository per run; the rest is caught up by follow-up runs.
lead.zh-Hant: 用 GitHub REST API 依更新時間游標讀取，每個 repo 每次最多 200 筆，其餘由後續的追趕 run 補上。

lead.en: Anonymous reads of the Apache Jira search API over a window that grows with the gap since the last success. The KIP-pages and identity-backfill jobs read it too.
lead.zh-Hant: 匿名讀取 Apache Jira 搜尋 API，時間視窗依上次成功至今的間隔放大。KIP 頁面與身分回填 job 也會讀它。

lead.en: KIP discussions and votes live here. Subjects starting `[jira]` or `[PR]` are dropped because those records already come from Jira and GitHub.
lead.zh-Hant: KIP 的討論與投票都在這裡。主旨以 `[jira]` 或 `[PR]` 開頭的信會被略過，因為這些已由 Jira 與 GitHub 收集。

v.en: One retry after a 5xx or 429; a response over 4 MiB fails that source as `too-large`; a failing source never blocks the others.
v.zh-Hant: 5xx 或 429 重試一次；回應超過 4 MiB 時該來源以 `too-large` 失敗；一個來源失敗不會擋住其他來源。

lead.en: Who reviewed what and when, without comment text; it feeds contributor profiles. The review queue and the identity backfill also read GitHub GraphQL.
lead.zh-Hant: 誰在何時 review 了什麼，不含留言內容；用於貢獻者頁面。Review 佇列與身分回填也會讀 GitHub GraphQL。

lead.en: Public ASF LDAP rosters (for the review queue and identity links) and the Confluence KIP pages (for KIP authors).
lead.zh-Hant: 公開的 ASF LDAP 名冊（供 review 佇列與身分連結使用）與 Confluence 上的 KIP 頁面（供 KIP 作者使用）。

lead.en: This repository's workflow runs, read through the public GitHub API by the SRE agent to see whether a deploy landed near a failure.
lead.zh-Hant: 本 repo 的 workflow 執行紀錄；SRE agent 透過公開的 GitHub API 讀取，看看故障前後是否有部署。

lead.en: Read once a day by the cost guard with a read-only analytics token.
lead.zh-Hant: 成本守門員每天用唯讀的 analytics token 讀一次。

lead.en: Reads every source sequentially from its cursor, inside the `PIPELINE_STATE` Durable Object's alarm.
lead.zh-Hant: 在 `PIPELINE_STATE` Durable Object 的 alarm 裡，依游標逐一讀取每個來源。

lead.en: A deterministic TypeScript materializer groups records into threads and extracts identifiers such as `KIP-1150` from titles and bodies. The same input always gives the same output.
lead.zh-Hant: 確定性的 TypeScript materializer 把紀錄整理成 thread，並從標題與內文抽出 `KIP-1150` 這類編號。相同輸入一定得到相同輸出。

lead.en: An immutable snapshot: a list of entries plus one detail object per thread. A detail is stored once under the SHA-256 of its bytes and reused by later releases (content addressing).
lead.zh-Hant: 不可變的快照：一份列表加上每個 thread 的詳細物件。詳細物件以內容的 SHA-256 為鍵只存一次，之後的 release 直接重用（內容定址）。

v.en: Dev 791 new + 7,796 reused objects; Prod 378 new + 7,596 reused
v.zh-Hant: Dev 新增 791、重用 7,796 個物件；Prod 新增 378、重用 7,596 個

lead.en: Chunks every thread, computes corpus statistics once, and writes BM25 shards plus a `terms.json` that says which shard holds each term. See [Search](search.html).
lead.zh-Hant: 把每個 thread 切成段落，一次算好語料統計，寫出 BM25 分片與記錄每個詞在哪些分片的 `terms.json`。詳見[搜尋](search.html)。

v.en: Dev 9,764 chunks in 11 shards; Prod 7,118 chunks in 8 shards
v.zh-Hant: Dev 9,764 段、11 個分片；Prod 7,118 段、8 個分片

lead.en: Objects are written first and the small `current.json` pointers last, so a reader sees either the old release or the new one, never half of one. The run then records what it wrote and what it cost.
lead.zh-Hant: 先寫物件，最後才更新小小的 `current.json` 指標，所以讀者看到的一定是完整的舊版或新版，不會看到一半。接著記錄這次寫了什麼、花了多少。

v.en: Dev 794 Class A / 8,590 Class B; Prod 381 / 7,977

lead.en: Per-person monthly activity files for contributor profiles (`PEOPLE_ACTIVITY=log@1`).
lead.zh-Hant: 為貢獻者頁面寫入每人每月的活動檔（`PEOPLE_ACTIVITY=log@1`）。

lead.en: The `search-embedding` job, started by each publication and continued hourly by the `SEARCH_EMBEDDING_RUN` Durable Object while chunks are pending. It turns each new search chunk into a vector, capped at 2,500 estimated neurons and 400 calls a day.
lead.zh-Hant: `search-embedding` job：每次發布後啟動，還有段落未處理時由 `SEARCH_EMBEDDING_RUN` Durable Object 每小時接續。它把新的搜尋段落轉成向量，每天上限 2,500 估計 neurons、400 次呼叫。

lead.en: Runs in the `DIGEST_RUN` Durable Object: classifies, summarises, validates and translates the last 7 days. `DIGEST_RUN` is bound on Prod too but the digest is off there. See [Weekly digest](digest.html).
lead.zh-Hant: 在 `DIGEST_RUN` Durable Object 中執行：分類、摘要、驗證並翻譯過去 7 天的動態。Prod 也綁了 `DIGEST_RUN`，但週報在 Prod 是關閉的。詳見[週報](digest.html)。

lead.en: The `github-reviews` job on the publication tick: review rows, reviewed pull requests' labels and KIP ids, and logins' public names, stored per month.
lead.zh-Hant: 在發布 tick 上執行的 `github-reviews` job：每月存下 review 紀錄、被 review 的 PR 的 label 與 KIP 編號，以及帳號的公開名稱。

title.zh-Hant: 身分連結、KIP 作者、回填

lead.en: `identity-backfill` reads older GitHub and Jira history; `identity-links` links GitHub, Jira and mailing-list identities only when corroborated (no upstream call); `kip-pages` reads KIP authors from the wiki. Each writes only its own internal prefix.
lead.zh-Hant: `identity-backfill` 讀取較舊的 GitHub 與 Jira 歷史；`identity-links` 只在有佐證時連結 GitHub、Jira 與郵件列表的身分（不呼叫上游）；`kip-pages` 從 wiki 讀出 KIP 作者。每個 job 只寫自己的 internal 前綴。

lead.en: The `review-queue` job lists pull requests waiting for a committer, using the ASF roster. It has no cron yet, and no API route serves it.
lead.zh-Hant: `review-queue` job 依 ASF 名冊列出等待 committer review 的 PR。目前沒有 cron，也沒有 API 路由提供它。

lead.en: The `retention` job runs in its own `PIPELINE_STATE` alarm, skips while a publication is running, lists release prefixes and detail pools, and reports what an enforce mode would delete. The code has no delete path.
lead.zh-Hant: `retention` job 在自己的 `PIPELINE_STATE` alarm 中執行，發布進行中就跳過；它列出 release 前綴與詳細物件池，回報 enforce 模式會刪除什麼。程式裡沒有刪除的路徑。

lead.en: The Worker's `AI` binding. Prod has it for the staged digest (Spec 014 D113), but no model runs on Prod while `DIGEST_ENABLED`, `SEARCH_EMBEDDING` and `SRE_AGENT` are off there. Every call goes through an AI Gateway, and the neurons it spends are charged to a daily ledger first.
lead.zh-Hant: Worker 的 `AI` binding。Prod 也已為尚未啟用的週報綁定（Spec 014 D113），但在 Prod 的 `DIGEST_ENABLED`、`SEARCH_EMBEDDING`、`SRE_AGENT` 都關閉時，Prod 不跑任何模型。每次呼叫都經過 AI Gateway，花掉的 neurons 會先記入每日帳本。

lead.en: Separate gateways keep each job's requests, cache and limits apart.
lead.zh-Hant: 分開的 gateway 讓各 job 的請求、快取與限制互不干擾。

v.en: `osskb-search-dev`: the embedding job and the query gate
`osskb-digest-dev`: 60 requests an hour, $2 a month; Prod `osskb-digest-prod` (exists, unused until the Prod digest is enabled)
v.zh-Hant: `osskb-digest-dev`：每小時 60 次、每月 2 美元；Prod 為 `osskb-digest-prod`（已建立，Prod 週報啟用前不會使用）

lead.en: The only mutable objects. Everything they point to is immutable, so rollback is a pointer change.
lead.zh-Hant: 唯一會變動的物件；它指向的內容都不可變，所以回復只要改指標。

lead.en: One release per run; details shared by content digest across releases.
lead.zh-Hant: 每次 run 一個 release；詳細物件依內容雜湊在各 release 間共用。

lead.en: Versioned independently of the feed, so the ranker can change without touching the feed.
lead.zh-Hant: 與 feed 分開版本化，排序演算法可以獨立更換。

title.zh-Hant: 週報與 review 佇列物件

lead.en: The English digest and its Traditional Chinese translation for one source release, and the review queue under `public/review-queue/v1/`.
lead.zh-Hant: 某一份來源 release 的英文週報與繁體中文翻譯，以及 `public/review-queue/v1/` 下的 review 佇列。

lead.en: Both the Worker and Pages bind `OSS_KB_BUCKET`. Only the Worker writes; Pages only reads.
lead.zh-Hant: Worker 與 Pages 都綁定 `OSS_KB_BUCKET`。只有 Worker 會寫；Pages 只讀。

lead.en: Evidence of each publication. Not served directly.
lead.zh-Hant: 每次發布的證據；不直接對外提供。

lead.en: Activity months, identity links and backfill, KIP authors, ASF roster caches and review rows under `internal/…/v1/`, read by the people API.
lead.zh-Hant: 活動月檔、身分連結與回填、KIP 作者、ASF 名冊快取與 review 紀錄，都在 `internal/…/v1/` 下，由人員 API 讀取。

lead.en: Run records, model trajectories, `state.json` and the Dev drill pointers. The agent's store refuses any key outside this prefix.
lead.zh-Hant: run 紀錄、模型軌跡、`state.json` 與 Dev 演練指標。agent 的儲存層拒絕寫入這個前綴以外的任何 key。

lead.en: `PIPELINE_STATE` holds each source's cursor, the current phase and the last run, so a crash resumes from the last committed cursor instead of starting over. It also runs retention in its own alarm.
lead.zh-Hant: `PIPELINE_STATE` 保存每個來源的游標、目前階段與上一次 run；程式中途掛掉時，會從最後提交的游標續跑，而不是從頭開始。retention 也在它自己的 alarm 中執行。

lead.en: `DIGEST_RUN` runs the digest and its neuron ledger. Bound in both environments; the digest is off on Prod.
lead.zh-Hant: `DIGEST_RUN` 執行週報與它的 neurons 帳本。兩個環境都有綁定；週報在 Prod 是關閉的。

lead.en: `SEARCH_EMBEDDING_RUN` tracks which release is embedded and how many chunks are pending.
lead.zh-Hant: `SEARCH_EMBEDDING_RUN` 記錄哪個 release 已轉成向量、還有多少段落待處理。

lead.en: `SEARCH_QUERY_GATE` is a Durable Object ledger that every semantic query must pass, so a public search box cannot overspend. Over budget means lexical results only. Pages reaches it through its own binding to the Dev Worker's class.
lead.zh-Hant: `SEARCH_QUERY_GATE` 是每個語意查詢都要經過的 Durable Object 帳本，讓公開搜尋框不會超支；超過預算就只回傳關鍵字結果。Pages 透過自己的 binding 連到 Dev Worker 的這個 class。

lead.en: `COST_GUARD_STATE` keeps the breaker and the last cost check in one storage key; no R2 operation.
lead.zh-Hant: `COST_GUARD_STATE` 用一個 storage key 保存斷路器與上一次成本檢查；不碰 R2。

lead.en: The `SEARCH_VECTORS` binding to index `osskb-search-dev`, one namespace per project: Cloudflare's vector database, behind a replaceable interface so it is never the public contract.
lead.zh-Hant: `SEARCH_VECTORS` binding，指向索引 `osskb-search-dev`，每個專案一個 namespace：Cloudflare 的向量資料庫，放在可替換的介面後面，不成為對外契約。

lead.en: Dev is public today: no Access application is in front of the Dev site, so query cost is bounded by the query gate, not by who may ask. The service-token tooling for tests and verification stays so Access can be turned on without code changes.
lead.zh-Hant: Dev 目前是公開的：Dev 網站前面沒有 Access 應用程式，所以查詢成本由查詢閘門控制，而不是靠限制誰能查。測試與驗證用的 service token 工具仍保留，日後開啟 Access 不必改程式。

lead.en: `/api/feed` and `/api/detail/:id` read the pointer, then the release, then one detail object through `OSS_KB_BUCKET`. Every 200 response is cached for 30 seconds with stale-while-revalidate 120. The browser never touches R2.
lead.zh-Hant: `/api/feed` 與 `/api/detail/:id` 透過 `OSS_KB_BUCKET` 先讀指標，再讀 release，再讀一個詳細物件。每個 200 回應快取 30 秒、stale-while-revalidate 120 秒。瀏覽器從不直接碰 R2。

lead.en: `/api/search` reads `current.json`, the manifest, `terms.json`, then only the shards a query term names; `/api/search-detail/:ref` opens one result. On Dev it also asks the query gate for semantic candidates.
lead.zh-Hant: `/api/search` 讀 `current.json`、manifest、`terms.json`，再只讀查詢詞出現的分片；`/api/search-detail/:ref` 開啟單一結果。Dev 上還會向查詢閘門要語意候選。

lead.en: The Pages binding `SEARCH_QUERY_GATE` reaches the Dev Worker's gate, which embeds the query and asks Vectorize; the results are fused with BM25 by thread.
lead.zh-Hant: Pages 的 binding `SEARCH_QUERY_GATE` 連到 Dev Worker 的閘門，閘門把查詢轉成向量再問 Vectorize；結果與 BM25 依 thread 融合。

lead.en: `/api/digest` returns 404 on Prod because the digest is off there.
lead.zh-Hant: 因為 Prod 未開啟週報，`/api/digest` 在 Prod 回 404。

lead.en: `/api/people`, `/api/people/:project` and `/api/people/:project/:id` (`PEOPLE_PROFILES`), and `/api/activity` for the project trend (`PROJECT_TREND`). Unset on Prod, so they answer 404 there.
lead.zh-Hant: `/api/people`、`/api/people/:project` 與 `/api/people/:project/:id`（`PEOPLE_PROFILES`），以及專案趨勢用的 `/api/activity`（`PROJECT_TREND`）。Prod 沒設，所以在 Prod 回 404。

lead.en: The digest: headline, highlights, KIP proposals, topic cards, collapsed routine maintenance, and on Dev the project trend.
lead.zh-Hant: 週報：標題、重點、KIP 提案、主題卡片、收合的例行維護，Dev 上還有專案趨勢。

lead.en: The thread list with search in the same view, and a detail page per thread with its full timeline and source links.
lead.zh-Hant: thread 列表與同一畫面的搜尋，以及每個 thread 的詳細頁（完整時間軸與來源連結）。

lead.en: One page per person: activity, reviews and, on Dev, the KIPs they authored.
lead.zh-Hant: 每人一頁：活動、review，以及 Dev 上他們撰寫的 KIP。

meta.zh-Hant: 逾時 > 24.5 小時 · 過期 > 27 小時

lead.en: Every view shows how old the data is, so a stalled publisher is visible without anyone reading logs.
lead.zh-Hant: 每個畫面都顯示資料多舊，發布器卡住時不必看 log 也看得出來。

lead.en: Public, read-only status of every job: the last publication's per-source success, objects written, R2 requests, search index size, AI spend today, and on Dev `digest`, `costGuard`, `signals` and `sreAgent`. It never returns credentials.
lead.zh-Hant: 公開、唯讀的各 job 狀態：上次發布各來源是否成功、寫了多少物件、R2 請求數、搜尋索引大小、今天的 AI 用量，Dev 上還有 `digest`、`costGuard`、`signals` 與 `sreAgent`。不會回傳任何憑證。

lead.en: Every job run writes one data point through `SIGNALS` to dataset `osskb_signals_dev`, then reads its previous points with `ANALYTICS_SQL` to evaluate rules such as a missed or failing job; the result is `/health.signals`.
lead.zh-Hant: 每個 job run 透過 `SIGNALS` 在資料集 `osskb_signals_dev` 寫一個資料點，再用 `ANALYTICS_SQL` 讀回先前的資料點，評估 job 漏跑、連續失敗等規則；結果放在 `/health.signals`。

lead.en: The daily `cost-guard` check reads the account's month-to-date cost and records the breaker in `/health.costGuard`. In monitor mode it refuses nothing; enforce would stop the AI jobs and pause the publication on an R2 Class A trip.
lead.zh-Hant: 每日的 `cost-guard` 檢查讀取帳號本月至今的成本，把斷路器狀態記在 `/health.costGuard`。monitor 模式下不擋任何東西；enforce 模式會停掉 AI job，並在 R2 Class A 超標時暫停發布。

lead.en: Every Worker invocation's logs, on both environments since `v0.3.2`. Pages has none.
lead.zh-Hant: 每次 Worker 呼叫的 log；自 `v0.3.2` 起兩個環境都有。Pages 沒有。

lead.en: A committed command that compares `/health` with what the site serves, for Dev or Prod, using GET only.
lead.zh-Hant: 版本庫內的指令，只用 GET 比對 `/health` 與網站實際提供的資料，可對 Dev 或 Prod 執行。

lead.en: Each `sre-agent` tick reads `/health` as served, the job's signal points through `ANALYTICS_SQL`, and CI runs from the GitHub API, then groups new firing rules by job into an evidence bundle.
lead.zh-Hant: 每個 `sre-agent` tick 讀取實際提供的 `/health`、透過 `ANALYTICS_SQL` 讀 job 的訊號資料點、從 GitHub API 讀 CI 執行紀錄，再把新觸發的規則依 job 整理成證據包。

lead.en: With `SRE_AGENT=live`, one tool-using loop per job on Workers AI through the `AI` binding and gateway `osskb-sre-dev`, guided by the playbook. Every evidence quote must match the bundle; the agent only suggests owner actions and never performs them.
lead.zh-Hant: `SRE_AGENT=live` 時，每個 job 透過 `AI` binding 與 gateway `osskb-sre-dev` 在 Workers AI 上跑一個會用工具的迴圈，依 playbook 判斷。每段證據引文都必須與證據包相符；agent 只建議負責人該做的事，從不自己執行。

lead.en: Writes trajectories, a run record and `state.json` under `internal/sre/v1/<env>/`, one `SIGNALS` data point with job `sre-agent`, and serves the last run as `/health.sreAgent`. A failed tick records `failed` and never reaches another job. Each tick is also traced (`traces.enabled`): the `sre-agent tick` span and every model call show in the Workers Observability Agents tab for 7 days.
lead.zh-Hant: 在 `internal/sre/v1/<env>/` 下寫入軌跡、run 紀錄與 `state.json`，寫一個 job 為 `sre-agent` 的 `SIGNALS` 資料點，並以 `/health.sreAgent` 提供上一次 run。失敗的 tick 記為 `failed`，不會影響其他 job。每個 tick 也會被追蹤（`traces.enabled`）：`sre-agent tick` span 與每次模型呼叫會在 Workers Observability 的 Agents 分頁保留 7 天。

lead.en: With `SRE_DRILL=on` on Dev, the owner can arm a fault in the `kip-pages` job and the next diagnosis is graded against it.
lead.zh-Hant: Dev 上 `SRE_DRILL=on` 時，負責人可以在 `kip-pages` job 埋入一個故障，下一次診斷會依此評分。
